experiment: Unloaded single-leg forward reposition from stable CAD-based pose

historical_correction.finding: Community CAD left/right suffixes are mirrored relative to Freenove control.py motor channels
historical_correction.note: Assert all six channel groups by motor number, not by apparent suffix

method.actual_toe_marker: Farthest tibia CAD mesh vertex; not physically verified rubber tip
method.controller: PD torque 7.0*(q_target-q)-0.32*qdot, 0.7Nm assumed cap; C1-continuous joint-space interpolation
method.support_constraint: None: feet and body are free, actual floor contacts are solved by MuJoCo
method.test_definition: One toe moves forward and recontacts; torso does not perform a forward locomotion step

remaining_validation: CAD suffix/channel wiring is checked but actual shaft directions, neutral PWM and per-leg calibration are unknown
Servo torque-speed, current, voltage sag, backlash, thermal limits and controller latency not calibrated
The foot shape is a convex hull proxy from original tibia CAD; true pads/contact materials unknown
No randomized perturbation or variable slope/friction stress tests have been run
One foot forward != full tripod or distributed walking and != true net body locomotion
No hardware has been purchased/commanded; original STEP/STL not redistributed
next_step: Repeat on alternate legs and ground conditions, then use local coordination rules to produce stable body displacement; do not assume transfer until real hardware calibration.
